cell_line.evidence: inferred: We applied this workflow to the proteogenomic analysis of spliceosome-defective K052 SRSF2(P95H) cells, demonstrating high-confidence identification of proteins isoforms arising from intron inclusion and non-canonical splicing, as well as improved overall estimation of false-discovery rate from the focused database assembled by ProteomeGenerator.

Human K052 cells were obtained from the Japanese Collection of Research Bioresources Cell Bank, identity confirmed using STR genotyping (Genetica DNA Laboratories, Burlington, NC), and cultured as described.
